attachments.text:
Stonebridge Harvest Run 5K - crowd notes
Sunday 10 October 2027 / contact Fatima Haddad 555-0120
total 1200 incl 1200 runners. Few people come just to watch.

VIEWING
3 barriered areas: finish the rowing club, turn at Old Mill Trail, start the old mill car park. approx 1600 total @ 2 per sqm. over expected numbers

START
3 waves, 4 min gaps, seeded by expected time. pens close 5 min before each wave

STEWARDS
24 stewards (approx 1:50), 3 supervisors, rota by position, briefing 1hr before

EXIT
runners one-way funnel to recovery, out north gate. spectators 2 marked exits, steward on each. clear in 25 mins

bg: committee done this race yrs. attendance growing slowly. helpers mostly members + family, many on rota before

CONTROL
Fatima Haddad at control w/ radio to all supervisors. can hold wave, stop race, use PA. sups call in if area getting full

attachments.name: medical_plan.txt
attachments.text:
Stonebridge Harvest Run 5K - medical notes
Sunday 10 October 2027 / gun 10:00 / 1200 runners / 5K
contact Fatima Haddad 555-0120
No ambulance will be stationed at the race; any ambulance would come through the 911 system.

FIRST AID
committee members w/ work first aid certs. kit at HQ tent + kit in lead car

WEATHER / WATER
water every 2.5k. forecast check -48h and -2h. >28C earlier start or shorter course. >32C cancel. foil + warm tent at finish if cold/wet

HOSPITAL
call 911 if needed, paramedics handle it from there

COMMS
radios on medical channel at all posts + bikes, phones backup. amb calls go via medical lead, who gives crew the barrier to come to

LEAD
Priya Raman, registered paramedic, on site from -1hr til last runner in. can withdraw any runner

attachments.name: race_plan.txt
attachments.text:
RACE PLAN
Stonebridge Harvest Run 5K | Sunday 10 October 2027
Organiser: Stonebridge Neighbourhood Council
Race director: Fatima Haddad
Reference: EV-12083

Overview
The Stonebridge Harvest Run 5K is a 5K race of 5 km for 1200 entrants, based in the Kingsway Gardens area of Port Halden. The start is at 10:00 and the course closes at 11:15.

Course
The course stays entirely on the Pier Promenade and the Old Mill Trail, away from the highway, and no road is closed for the race. The finish is at the rowing club.

Course dimensions
Usable width on the Pier Promenade is 12 m and on the Old Mill Trail 12 m, with lawn or open paving beside the course for almost the whole distance. The finish area measures roughly 120 m by 60 m.

Support
Entrants collect numbers from the old mill car park from one hour before the start. Timing is by chip, with mats at the start and finish. Results are posted on the Stonebridge website the same day.
